as_told.title: Touring George Knapp through Los Alamos after going public

plain: In 1989, Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, says he brought the Las Vegas TV journalist George Knapp into Los Alamos, the New Mexico weapons laboratory, in a visit that "was not all 100% legal." Lazar tells Michels that Knapp "just walked around, filmed everything, spoke to people that I worked with," and that they rode right into the experimental areas, where Lazar said, "George, this is my desk." Lazar tells it as his own memory, and it would show that he really worked at the lab, which is a disputed point in his story.
